name: Enhance Physique
body:
Design alteration; Level 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Fortitude negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You enhance a target’s physique, making it stronger, tougher, or more agile. This functions as your choice of either bear’s endurance, bull’s strength, or cat’s grace, except as noted here.

Overload: For every two runic charges overloaded into this script, you can grant the enhancement bonus to an additional ability score.
